title: Elon Musk is 'truly a genius,' says Vladimir Putin | TechCrunch
summary: After the U.S. eased sanctions on Russia earlier this month, Ukrainian officials became concerned that Ukraine could lose access to Starshield, the military version of Musk’s Starlink network, which Ukrainian forces rely on.
